title: Across the Universe: The DC Universe Stories of Alan Moore (DC Comics, 2003)
descriptionText:
Across the Universe: The DC Universe Stories of Alan Moore (DC Comics, 2003) TPB – Introduction by Dave Gibbons
Condition: Excellent / Like New
🪐 Description:
Step inside the mind of one of comics’ greatest writers — Alan Moore, the visionary behind Watchmen, V for Vendetta, Swamp Thing, and The Killing Joke.
Across the Universe: The DC Universe Stories of Alan Moore collects Moore’s most iconic and hard-to-find stories for DC’s legendary heroes, written before his revolutionary creator-owned works. With an introduction by Dave Gibbons (artist of Watchmen), this volume showcases the storytelling brilliance that redefined modern comics.
🦸‍♂️ Featuring Classic Stories From:
Superman Annual #11 — “For the Man Who Has Everything” (with Dave Gibbons)
Batman Annual #11 — “Mortal Clay” (with George Freeman)
Green Lantern Corps Annual #2–3 — “Tygers” & “In Blackest Night” (with Kevin O’Neill & Bill Willingham)
The Omega Men #26–27 — “Brief Lives” & “A Man’s World”
Secret Origins #10 — “Footsteps” (with Jim Aparo & Joe Orlando)
DC Comics Presents #85 — “The Jungle Line” (Superman & Swamp Thing crossover)
📖 Contents:
Collects eleven stories originally published between 1985–1987, presented together for the first time.
Includes remastered art and restored coloring by DC Comics.
🎨 Featuring Collaborations With:
Dave Gibbons, Kevin O’Neill, Paris Cullins, Rick Veitch, John Byrne, Al Williamson, Bill Willingham, and more.
📚 Details:
Publisher: DC Comics
Publication Year: 2003
ISBN: 1-4012-0087-7
Cover Artist: Dave Gibbons
Format: Softcover / Trade Paperback
Pages: ~192
Genre: Superhero / Anthology
📸 Condition Notes:
Excellent condition — cover bright and glossy
Spine tight, no creases or corner damage
Interior pages clean, bright, and unmarked
Very light shelf wear (see photos for details)
